name: Sump Pump
summary: Pumps groundwater out of the basement sump pit to keep it dry.
education: Sump pumps fail at the worst possible time — during the heavy rain that triggered them. A backup battery or water-powered backup is what stands between you and a flooded basement when the power goes out.

questions.prompt: Is there a backup pump or battery?

suggested_photos.prompt: Looking down into the sump pit
Discharge pipe where it exits the house

maintenance.action: Test by pouring water into the pit
maintenance.why: A pump that hasn't run in months may seize. Testing ensures it kicks on.
Sealed lead-acid batteries lose capacity invisibly until the day you need them.
Gravel and silt jam the float switch — the most common failure mode.
